subject.title: feat(session): add named new and close chat commands

question: Should OpenClaw add chat-side `/close`/`/delete` plus explicit `/new --name` session naming now, or should this wait for the broader session title and UI-management direction?
rationale: The implementation changes user-facing command grammar and adds a destructive session-management command, which is product-sensitive even after the parser bug is fixed.

options.title: Keep and repair this PR
options.body: Require the parser fix, conflict resolution, current-head proof, and then decide the destructive command UX before merge.

options.title: Pause for title-contract work
options.body: Wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95182 to settle the canonical `title`/`label` contract before adding more naming commands.

options.title: Split destructive commands
options.body: Allow explicit `/new --name` to proceed separately while moving `/close` and `/delete` into a narrower follow-up.

recommendation.title: Keep and repair this PR
recommendation.body: Require the parser fix, conflict resolution, current-head proof, and then decide the destructive command UX before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice spans model-selection compatibility, command grammar, and session-state product surface.
